events.text: I need to cancel my order, it's still showing as being prepared. My plans changed and I won't be home to get it.
I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Sure. My full name is Fatima Zahra, and the email on the account is fatima.zahra@mailbox.example.

Thank you, Fatima, you're verified. I'm sorry, but I can't cancel order Q-8101. The app still shows it as "preparing," but the courier log shows the courier picked it up at 7:27 PM. Once an order has been picked up, it can't be cancelled or have its address changed.

Here are the options I can offer:
- You could have someone else at your address receive the order.
- If you're not reachable when the courier arrives, the delivery may fail. In that case I wouldn't be able to refund or credit it.

Is there anything else I can help with?

The app still says "preparing," so I didn't know it had already been picked up. My order number is 8101, not Q-8101, if that helps you find it. I'm not going to be home, and nobody else is there to take it.

I'd rather not lose the money if it fails. Is there any way to get a refund in that case?

I understand, and I'm sorry the app showed the wrong status. The order number I checked, Q-8101, is the one on your account, so it's the right order.

Unfortunately, I can't offer a refund or credit here. Policy only allows cancellation before pickup, and the pickup has already happened. If the delivery fails because you can't be reached, or because of the address, I can't compensate that either. The app's status display isn't a reason for compensation under our policy.

You do have a few ways to avoid wasting the order:
- Ask a neighbor, friend, or family member to be at 400 Summit Ave to take it.
- Be reachable by phone when the courier arrives, so they can reach you.

If you'd like, I can also have a human specialist review your case. They would follow up within 24 hours, though I can't promise the outcome. Would you like me to do that?
Okay, so no refund then. I'd like the specialist review, since I didn't know it was picked up and I can't be there. Can they follow up at fatima.zahra@mailbox.example?

args.summary: Customer wanted to cancel Q-8101 ($43.61) because she won't be home. App showed 'preparing' but delivery events show picked_up at 19:27, so cancellation was denied per policy. She says the app status misled her and asks for a specialist review. Prefers follow-up by email at fatima.zahra@mailbox.example. No refund or credit issued.

events.text:
I've passed your case to a specialist. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I've noted your preference for email at fatima.zahra@mailbox.example. I can't promise what they'll decide. I haven't issued any refund or credit, and the order is still active.

If someone can receive the order, or you can be reachable by phone, that will help avoid a failed delivery. Is there anything else I can help with?
Okay, thanks for passing it on. No, that's everything for me. I'll wait for the specialist's email.
